user.title: InPost - login
user.description:
1. Open the [InPost login page]({login_url}) in a browser.
2. Log in with the phone number of your InPost account (SMS + captcha).
3. After login the browser lands on an address starting with `https://account.inpost-group.com/callback?code=...` (the page may be blank or show an error - that is expected).
4. Copy the WHOLE address from the address bar and paste it below.

setup_options.title: InPost - options
setup_options.description: Pick phones (from HA Companion) for distance and notifications. All optional - you can skip and configure later via 'Configure'.

data.device_trackers: Phones (you can pick several - distance taken to whichever phone is closest)
data.notify_distance_m: Notify when parcel is closer than (m) [0 = disabled]
data.notify_cooldown_hours: Per-parcel cooldown (hours) - do not notify more often than this

reauth_confirm.title: InPost - re-login ({phone})
reauth_confirm.description:
The session expired or InPost changed its login method.

1. Open the [InPost login page]({login_url}) in a browser.
2. Log in with the phone number **{phone}** (SMS + captcha).
3. After login the browser lands on an address starting with `https://account.inpost-group.com/callback?code=...` (the page may be blank or show an error - that is expected).
4. Copy the WHOLE address from the address bar and paste it below.

error.invalid_callback: This does not look like a login callback address (no `code=`) or it comes from an older attempt. Paste the whole address from the browser.
error.sms_code: That is the SMS code - enter it on the InPost page, then paste the address the browser lands on here.
error.invalid_auth: InPost rejected the login code (used or expired). Open the link again and log in once more.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to InPost. Try again.
error.cannot_identify: Logged in, but the account phone number could not be determined.
error.wrong_account: You logged in with a different number than this entry. Log out on the InPost page and use the right number.

abort.already_configured: An account with this phone number is already configured.
